messages:
mika: Heads-up 1 SakuraCompute (JP SI) wants an embargoed joint announcement for Redwood Private + Datadog tracing onboarding. Marketing asked for a minimal asset list and a timeline. Can we list required pieces and owners?
leo: We already have OTLP export hooks in the runtime, but Sakura needs a VPC-friendly guide showing how to route traces to Datadog from their collector. Can we provide a one-file forwarder example and a tiny diagram?
priya: Happy to coordinate on the SI side and confirm their engineering availability. Sakura prefers demo material in JP locale (slides + short eng transcript).
tara: I can take screenshots and a dashboard JSON for Datadog (so SI can import). Need a sample traced request and a dev VPC with a test model.
jamie: Marketing wants 3 assets: 30s demo clip (no customer data), 2 hero screenshots, and a 1-paragraph partner quote. They need everything 4 business days before the announce date.
mika: Proposed announce date is Thu two weeks out. That means assets due by next Fri. Is that feasible?
leo: If engineering can hand off the forwarder config and an onboarding token by Tue, Sakura can wire it and we can capture traces Wed/Thu. I'll draft the collector config.
leo: Example OTLP config they can use with our enrichment header (replace API_KEY):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    apikey: "<API_KEY>"
processors:
  batch:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
priya: Sakura asked about trace sampling defaults. We should recommend 100% for demo, with a note to reduce to 5-10% in prod.
tara: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) dashboard shows p50/p95 latency widgets; 2) traced span contains model.name and model.version tags; 3) one exemplar trace with full request/response span chain and request_id that matches demo logs.
jamie: Add compliance line: "demo recordings scrubbed; no PII or customer data." Also ask legal to review partner quote.
mika: Assignments: mika = secure dev VPC creds (today), leo = fork a collector example + token docs (tomorrow), tara = dashboard JSON + screenshots (next Wed), priya = coordinate Sakura test window and JP transcript (this week), jamie = marketing copy + partner quote coordination (next Mon).
(Assigning in thread)
dd-integrations-bot: smoke-runner: sakura-private-trace-demo passed integration smoke on staging (run #78) :white_check_mark:
leo: Great. With that pass we can schedule a recording slot. I'll also prepare a tiny sequence diagram for the assets pack.
priya: I'll confirm Sakura's engineers for Wed recording and ask if they want English captions.
mika: Thanks all. I'll update this thread when I have the VPC creds and legal check completed. :thumbsup:
